page.layout: One printed page (right side), with the cut-off edge of the facing left page at the far left. Running head at top, page number at top right. Main text block: one paragraph continued from the previous page, then the closing word FINIS. No notes in the right margin. The left strip is the neighbouring page's edge and is left out.

main_text.p: te inhærente, de opere operato, de merito congrui: sed hæc inter priuatas opiniones fra-terculorum circumferebantur, donec tan-dem in Concilio Tridentino perniciosæ istæ speculationes pro Ecclesiasti-cis dogmatibus statue-rentur.

page.notes: The left strip shows fragments of the facing page's right margin (e.g. "di-", "re", "gra", "est", "m", "is.", "ti-", "a-", "n.", "le-"). These belong to the neighbouring page's edge and are left out. The first word "te" is the end of a word begun on the previous page; the first letters are cut off by the page edge, so it is marked as a fragment. Long s in "istæ" and "speculationes" and "Ecclefiasti-" is written as plain s. Heavy scan wear and show-through lie in the lower half of the page; no further printed text is legible there.
